tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250zab lam thugs sgrub yid bzhin nor bu'i mchod phreng rgyas par spro na/ 1$0000300

phyi mchod chu gnyis nyer spyod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: lha rdzas las grub chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga: kun bzang rnam 'phrul phyi yi mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai bid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: 'dod yon lnga ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: lha rdzas las grub 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: kun bzang rnam 'phrul phyi yi mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she kā ma gu ṇa pra tīts+tsha swā hā: nang mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: rang byung lhun grub dbang po'i me tog sogs: drag po'i longs spyod nang gi mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra ma hā puṣ+pe dhū pe dī pe gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da pū dza ho: gsang mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: bde stong mnyam sbyor rtog tshogs dbyings su bsgral: gnyis med rig pa gsang ba'i mchod par 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol:

oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dharma kā ya: saṃ bho kā ya: nirma kā ya maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā ra dzñā na su kha ho: sman mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: sku lnga ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar sman gyi mchod pa 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: pad+ma rdor 'chang rigs lnga'i thod phreng rtsal: gu ru mtshan brgyad lha sras mchog grub rgyal: sangs rgyas ye shes mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal la: sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: dri med kun dga' pad+ma mdo sngags gling: rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khro'i lha: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung gter bdag la: sman mchod 'bul lo mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛta khā hi: dngos grub blang ba ni/ kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra a mṛta sid+dhi pha la ho: rak+ta'i mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: snang srid dmar gyi rgya mtsho chen por bskyil: chags bral bde stong rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā rak+ta khā hi: gtor mchod ni/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma sku gsum dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la: dngos su 'byor bshams yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i: snod bcud 'byor tshogs bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs: 'dod 'byung dpal gyi gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul: zag med bde chen bskyed phyir bzhes nas kyang: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal du gsol: ma hā ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi:
